acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive and data-dependent mode, with a single MS scan
alkylation reagent: Alkylation was done with 55 mM Iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3
alkylation concentration: Alkylation was done with 55 mM Iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3
cleavage agent: After 1D SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and trypsin digestion of the SOM and IOM of the two biominerals
collision energy: Ions selected for MS/MS scan were fragmented using higher energy collision dissociation (HCD) at normalized collision energy of 28%
fractionation method: After 1D SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and trypsin digestion of the SOM and IOM of the two biominerals
fragmentation method: Ions selected for MS/MS scan were fragmented using higher energy collision dissociation (HCD)
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher, Germany)
labeling: We quantified the relative abundance of proteins (Additional file 3 sheet#1) in the four OM fractions using two label-free methods: exponentially modified protein abundance index (emPAI) and weighted spectral count (WS).
reduction reagent: Reduction was performed using 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) in 100 mM NH4HCO3
reduction concentration: Reduction was performed using 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) in 100 mM NH4HCO3
